findings.passage: To rush to judgment, I think is a bit premature, on what we should do.
findings.note: CBS News interview quoting then-Rep. Scott after the Newtown shooting. He says it is too early to decide on gun laws and wants to wait for the president's commission report. On the assault weapons ban he said: "I would love to see what comes out of the committee."
